project_info.color_palette: Two bold contrasting risograph inks only

main_subject.detail: The word [KEYWORD] becomes the main visual object, shaped or distorted to embody its meaning, with one symbolic flat illustration.
main_subject.style: Minimal flat risograph print, cinematic-surreal graphic poster

items: Integrated: a minimal flat symbolic figure or object.
Bottom or edge: poetic short quote.
Background: clean two-color field with visible print grain.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: No gradients, restrained risograph misregistration and tactile ink texture

assets.name: Kinetic word-poster reference
assets.usage: Match vertical hierarchy and type-led metaphor.

prompt_instructions: Use exactly two bold contrasting colors and no gradients.
Keep the illustration subordinate to the word's visual meaning.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a surreal 2D poster design based on the word '[KEYWORD]' - the layout should be dominated by kinetic typography where the word is visually shaped or distorted to reflect its meaning - integrate a symbolic flat minimal illustration that reinforces the concept - the style must be inspired by risograph print: only 2 bold contrasting colors (no gradients) - include a poetic, short quote that resonates emotionally with the keyword - background must be clean and minimal - composition must be vertical, with strong visual impact and artistic balance - the overall tone should feel cinematic, surreal, and graphic - ultra-sharp, high-resolution, no clutter.
prompt.negative_prompt: gradients, more than two colors, photorealism, clutter, generic typography, illegible quote, watermark, signature
